Appointments & C., by the Governors
North central Province provincial council
Appointments made by the Hon. Governor

I do hereby notify that following appointments have been made by virtue of the power vested on Hon. Governor of North Central Provincial Council as per the instruction given by Hon. Governor under provisions made by Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987.

1. Mrs. P.H. Wijesinghe Officer in Grade II of Sri Lanka Administrative Service in addition to the duties of his permanent post for acting as the Commissioner of Motor Traffic of North Central Province with effect from 01.01.2024 until further order is made. 2. Mr. J. Raliyudeen Officer in Grade II of Sri Lanka Administrative Service in addition to the duties of his permanent post for acting as the Cooperative Development Commissioner from 09.01.2024 to 03.06.2024 and appointing as Cooperative Development Commissioner and registrar of (Accounts and Payment) of the treasury of the North Central Province on full time with effect from 04.06.2024 until further notice is made.

3. Mrs. R.W.R.M.C. Ranawarana , Officer in Grade II of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Director Industrial Development of North Central Province with effect from 17.01.2024 on full time until further an order is made.

4. Mr. W.M.C.K. Wanninayaka , Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for the period of from 29.01.2024 to 13.08.2024, as the Secretary of Health of the North Central Provincial Council.

5. Mrs. P. S. Wimalaweera , Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service with effect from 30.01.2024 to as the Deputy Chief Secretary (Admin) of the office of the Chief Ministry of North Central Provincial Council until further an order is made.

6. Mrs. P. S. Wimalaweera , Officer in special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service in addition to the duties of his permanent post for acting as the Secretary of North Central Province with effect from 30.01.2024 to 29.02.2024.
7. Mr. N. H. R. Nishantha, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Administrative Service acting as Secretary of North Central Province full time with effect from 01.03.2024 until further order is made.

8. Mr. D. P. A. S. Dissanayaka, Officer in Grade II of Sri Lanka Administrative Service to perform duties as the Commissioner of Local Government full time with effect from 01.03.2024 untill further order is made.

9. Mr. W. G. W. Wanasinghe, Officer in special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the secretary to the Governor of North Central Province with effect from 22.05.2024 until further order is made.

10. Mr. K. M. H. S. K. Jayalath, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of Ministry of Agriculture of North Central Provincial Council with effect from 22.05.2024 until further order is made.

11. Mr. D. G. S. Dharmasena, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of the Chief Ministry of North Central Province with effect from 27.05.2024 until further order is made.

12. Mr. P. J. R. A. W. C. Ranasinghe, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of Ministry of Co-operative of North Central Province for the period of 27.05.2024 to 28.08.2024.

13. Miss. H. P. P. A. Hewapathirana, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of the Ministry of Irrigation of North Central Province with effect from 27.05.2024 until further order is made.

14. Mr. R. M. G. Senarathna, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of Ministry of Health of the North Central Province with effect form 21.08.2024 until further order is made.

15. Mrs. G. C. Muthuwaththa, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Animal Product and Health Service for acting as the Provincial Director of Animal Production and Health Department with effect from 10.09.2024 until further an order is made.

16. W. G. W. Wanasinghe, Secretary to the governor Officer, in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service in addition to the duties of his permanent post for acting as Secretary of Ministry of Co-operative of North Central Province with effect from 11.09.2024.

17. Mr. S. M. W. Samarakoon, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service as the Director of Education of North Central Province with effect from 11.09.2024 until further an order is made.
